teaser: "After you." Someone in the voting line waves you forward, tired of waiting for their own choice, and you take the space before the sentence finishes. Life path 8 is built on turning openings into outcomes — money, standing, the deal closed before the other side finishes reading it. ESTP is built on seeing the opening first and moving on it, no committee, no second draft. Crossed, you get a particular kind of mover: someone who treats the material world as a live game already in motion, winning rounds other people are still debating whether to play.
excerpt: Keys turn in the ignition before the sentence someone started is finished — you back the car out of the choir practice lot while the sentence still hangs, the evening already read as over before it got said aloud.
